{{Short description|German mathematician (1891–1979)}}
[[File:Erich Schönhardt.jpg|thumb|Image of Erich Schönhardt]]
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2024}}
'''Erich Schönhardt''' (25 June 1891 – 29 November 1979)<ref name="maier">{{citation|title=Geschichte der Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gesellschaft im Nationalsozialismus|volume=16|first=Helmut|last=Maier|publisher=Wallstein Verlag|year=2007|isbn=978-3-8353-0109-2|pages=618–619}}.</ref><ref name="dmv">[https://www.dmv.mathematik.de/die-dmv/105-kurzbiographien/385-kurzbiographien-s-saa-schr.html Short biographies of mathematicians SA–SCHO] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090627042608/http://dmv.mathematik.de/die-dmv/105-kurzbiographien/385-kurzbiographien-s-saa-schr.html |date=27 June 2009 }}, [[German Mathematical Society]], retrieved 5 December 2009.</ref> was a [[Germans|German]] [[mathematician]] known for his 1928 discovery of the [[Schönhardt polyhedron]], a non-convex polyhedron that cannot be partitioned into [[tetrahedron|tetrahedra]] without introducing additional [[vertex (geometry)|vertices]].<ref>{{citation
 | last = Schönhardt
 | first = E.
 | journal = Math. Annalen
 | pages = 309–312
 | title = Über die Zerlegung von Dreieckspolyedern in Tetraeder
 | url = http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=27796
 | archive-url = https://archive.today/20130106133835/http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/no_cache/dms/load/img/?IDDOC=27796
 | url-status = dead
 | archive-date = 6 January 2013
 | doi = 10.1007/BF01451597
 | volume = 98
 | year = 1928
 | s2cid = 116091853
 | url-access = subscription
 }}.</ref>

Schönhardt studied at the [[University of Stuttgart]],<ref name="dmv"/> and went on to do his graduate studies at the [[University of Tübingen]], receiving his Ph.D. in 1920 for a thesis on [[Schottky group]]s<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Erich Schönhardt|id=65835}}.</ref> under the supervision of [[Ludwig Maurer]].<ref name="dmv"/>
In the 1930s, he was the ''Dozentenführer'' ([[Nazi]] political leader of the faculty) at Tübingen,<ref name="dmv"/><ref name="segal"/> and was responsible for denouncing fellow Tübingen mathematician [[Erich Kamke]] for having married a [[Jewish]] woman.<ref name="segal">{{citation|title=Mathematicians under the Nazis|first=Sanford L.|last=Segal|publisher=Princeton University Press|year=2003|isbn=978-0-691-00451-8|pages=105, 176}}.</ref> He moved back to the University of Stuttgart in 1936<ref name="dmv"/> and was [[Rector (academia)|rector]] there from 1939 to 1942.<ref name="maier"/><ref name="dmv"/><ref>[http://www.historische-kommission-muenchen-editionen.de/rektoratsreden/anzeige/index.php?type=universitaet&id=172 Rectorate of the University of Stuttgart], Historic Commission of the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].</ref> He was a permanent editor of the journal ''[[Deutsche Mathematik]]''.
